subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the small cream-colored tracked robot in <Picture 1>, with a rounded rectangular head, gray circular ear panels, two cyan circular eyes, an orange knitted scarf, articulated metal hands and two black caterpillar tracks. <Picture 1> supplies robot identity and materials only. Its illuminated lamp and lighting are not transferred.
<Subject 2> is the orange tabby kitten in <Picture 2>, with amber eyes, a white muzzle and chest, pink nose and damp fur. <Picture 2> supplies kitten identity only. Its window position and illuminated background lamp are not transferred.
<Subject 3> is the clock repair workshop and brass desk lamp in <Picture 3>, including the worn wooden workbench, green wall, pendulum clock, blue rainy window and lamp on the right. This image supplies spatial layout and the initially unlit lamp. The robot in it does not redefine <Subject 1>.

<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre and delivery reference for an off-screen narrator (S1). Only the spoken vocal layer supplies a reference. Source dialogue, music and sound effects are not copied.

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] The robot chooses to spend its remaining battery to light a lamp beside the cold kitten. One continuous shot has one cause and one visible result: the connector engages, then the lamp warms the kitten. Duration approximately 5.17 seconds.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - cream body, rounded head, gray ear panels, cyan eyes, orange scarf, metal hands and black tracks.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - orange tabby markings, amber eyes, white muzzle and chest, damp fur.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - workshop layout and initially dark brass lamp are retained; any later lighting change follows the described action.

<Audio 1>: reference - the narrator follows the voice timbre and restrained cadence without copying the original signal or words.

detailed_description:
Cinematic tactile 3D animation with soft practical light, subdued colors and a warm emotional tone. Preserve the same world scale and materials for both characters. Identity references define appearance; they do not force their original backgrounds into the target shot.
[Shot 1] A locked medium-wide view establishes <Subject 3>. <Subject 1> stands left of the single brass desk lamp; <Subject 2> is already sitting on the workbench to the lamp's right. The lamp is physically dark, and cool blue rain light outlines both subjects. The robot has a small steady red low-battery indicator on its chest. A short cable runs from the lamp base toward the robot; its connector is held immediately in front of the robot's chest port. Both hands and the port remain visible without an extreme close-up. The kitten watches the connector rather than looking at the camera.
From the opening to 1.55 seconds, the robot glances toward the shivering kitten, pauses, then turns its eyes to the connector. Its scarf and track geometry stay consistent. Its body stays on the same part of the bench. The kitten makes one small shiver and then waits; the bench is solid under all four paws.
Between 1.55 and 3.51 seconds, the robot carefully pushes the connector the final small distance into the chest port. Its right hand supports the plug while the other steadies it. A quiet mechanical click occurs only when the connector seats. Only after that click, the lamp bulb starts to glow and smoothly reaches a gentle amber brightness. The lamp shade, stem and base remain in their original positions. This single connection is the only power event.
For the remainder, the robot releases the seated connector and lowers its hand. The kitten slowly relaxes its shoulders and brings its front paws together in the warm pool of light. A faint lamp hum follows the click. The robot's red battery indicator becomes dimmer while its cyan eyes remain visible. Hold this clear result through the final frame. The camera, character positions and lamp geometry stay stable. No cut, time jump, duplicate characters or visible text.

Within [Shot 1], an off-screen narrator (S1) uses the voice timbre referenced from <Audio 1>. The delivery is intimate and restrained: a quiet breath before the line, a short pause after the first phrase, and gentle warmth on the final word. The narrator says, <d>[Chinese] 最后一点电，也想留给你。</d> Start the line after the opening moment and finish before the final frame. Neither the robot nor the kitten speaks or moves a mouth to match this voice. Keep rain and the connector click soft beneath the narration.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet rain outside, soft workshop room tone, one connector click and a faint lamp hum. The only speech is the off-screen narrator described in [Shot 1]. No singing or crowd sounds.
